name: Transcend Information, Inc.
summary: Transcend Information, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, processing, and trading of computer software and hardware, peripheral equipment, and computer parts in Taiwan, rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers internal and portable solid-state drive, external drive, dashcam, secret recorder, memory card, flash drive, and memory module, as well as care readers, DVD burners, and accessories. It also provides customized services comprising customized screen-printed USB flash drives and preloaded content services.
